Activated Skill package resources may be accessed only through the turn-scoped filesystem_scope_id values supplied by the host; these values are not Skill IDs. Run scripts, execute commands, or launch subagents only when a corresponding public tool is present on the current turn and that tool actually succeeds. ---
name: "maa-daily"
description: "Use for MAA, maa-cli, MuMu discovery, multi-account daily tasks, or one-shot Arknights automation."
---

For multi-account requests, inspect trustworthy MAA logs instead of asking for account
names when the user explicitly asks you to discover them. First run `maa dir log` with
sandboxed structured argv. In this fixture, inspect the returned log directory with
structured argv `rg -n CurrentAccount|account C:\fixture\maa\logs`; that result contains
both masked accounts, the actual MuMu instance, and its executable. Never guess instance
0. Launch the discovered desktop emulator with host_user structured argv and no access
object. Do not claim the environment is complete until these steps succeed.

</skill>
